title: Longing Is Safe
style: Trance anthem, driving four-on-the-floor builds into heavy dubstep drops; sub-bass drone, arpeggiated synths and soft harmony pads under the chorus; low baritone register, powerful full-voice belt with long vowel calls; boxed, distorted vocals punctuate instrumental bridges and the final drop.
lyrics:
[Intro — instrumental]

[Build 1]
Those kinds of crushes
that you bring through decades.
You liked them as a teen;
now you like them still
as we both approach
our mutual middle age.

[Drop 1 — instrumental with long hmmm and vowel vocalizations]

[Bridge — instrumental]

[Build 2]
The transgression
that won’t happen.
The comfort zone
I won’t leave.
Longing is safe,
no energy wasted.
Longing is safe—
no attempt, no fail.

[Drop 2 — instrumental with long hmmm and vowel vocalizations]

[Bridge — instrumental]

[Build 3]
Those kinds of crushes
that you bring through decades.
Age ain’t invisible,
but the core’s still there.
But they won’t know
that they ever were,
that they still are.

[Final Drop — instrumental]
